observation: MYC transcript is the top upregulated gene in WWOX-deficient radial glia and the MYC-positive fraction of SOX2+ cells is raised in knockout and in two further lines (organoids, week 16); MYC protein also by immunoblot (2D NSCs, unguided organoids) and MYC ChIP-seq in knockout NSCs (E80)
possible_role: state or composition marker (not yet a role)
outcome_to_measure: already measured: transcript in single cells; protein fraction in organoids of single-digit n

observation: MYC elevation occurs without the radial-glia composition phenotype in the SCAR12-class line
possible_role: MYC elevation is not sufficient for the composition phenotype
outcome_to_measure: absolute counts per organoid of SOX2+MYC+ cells and of other progenitor-state markers in matched lines
control_experiment: compare MYC-high and MYC-low cells within the same cell-cycle phase and potency stratum

observation: POU5F1 is also among the genes with capped significance in the knockout radial-glia contrast (MYC effect about twice POU5F1's)
possible_role: retained progenitor state is compatible; a MYC-specific driver is neither shown nor excluded by this
outcome_to_measure: absolute counts per organoid of SOX2+MYC+ cells and of other progenitor-state markers in matched lines
control_experiment: compare MYC-high and MYC-low cells within the same cell-cycle phase and potency stratum

observation: Cell-cycle shift toward S and G2M is modest (density curves near-superimposed) and MYC is phase-coupled only in the knockout
possible_role: MYC rise could be a consequence of cell-cycle and maturity state
outcome_to_measure: MYC protein and MYCN, MYCL by phase in sorted or imaged cells; FUCCI-type or EdU-pulse readout
control_experiment: isogenic corrected line sampled at matched stage and phase

observation: WWOX loss moves MYC in non-neural WWOX systems (restoration lowers Myc in a Trp53-null mouse cell system; WWOX is a negative regulator of c-MYC in breast cancer cells); upstream lesion raising MYC is also seen in another neural-progenitor disease
action: restore WWOX in progenitors at a defined stage and read MYC, MYCN and MYCL
outcome_to_measure: MYC protein within 1 to 3 cell cycles after restoration versus targets of progenitor state later
control_experiment: re-express a catalytic or WW-domain mutant to separate which function lowers MYC

observation: In an isogenic human progenitor model with a different upstream lesion, genetic lowering of MYC restored maturation (neurites, calcium response) and an antimitotic did not
possible_role: MYC as effector that maintains progenitor state in that model (driver of the maturation block in that model)
action: lower MYC genetically in WWOX-deficient progenitors during the neuronal differentiation window
outcome_to_measure: maturation markers and per-organoid counts (NEUN, CTIP2, SATB2), progenitor pool (SOX2+, absolute), cell death
possible_compound: genetic first (shRNA or inducible degron); chemical only after a tool is shown to lower MYC in these cells
control_experiment: same lowering in the corrected line to show whether it only accelerates differentiation everywhere; a proliferation-only arrest as in the source

observation: In chick tissue and mouse neural stem cells MYC gain drives neurogenesis and exhausts the radial-glial pool; MYC loss early shrinks the pool, late loss redirects to glia; MYCN loss is compensated by c-myc in chick
possible_role: MYC raised may be pro-neurogenic or compensatory, not harmful by default; MYC lowering risks pool loss or fate shift (a hypothesis about WWOX-deficient cells; all cited rows are other systems)
action: graded (not total) lowering with a time window; measure pool, fate and death together
outcome_to_measure: SOX2+ pool, TBR2+ intermediates, NEUN+ neurons, GFAP/S100B glia, caspase-3, all as absolute counts
control_experiment: dominant-negative arm against knockdown arm; MYCN readout to catch compensation

observation: G1 shortening alone favours self-renewal over differentiation (mouse); a MYC-independent cell-cycle lever is untested in WWOX-deficient progenitors (the nocodazole result cannot test this: a microtubule poison, E27)
possible_role: cell-cycle shift as consequence or as parallel contributor to the maturation block
action: lengthen G1 or slow S and G2M without lowering MYC, in a defined window
outcome_to_measure: maturation markers, MYC protein (does it stay high?), absolute counts
control_experiment: MYC lowering arm run in parallel; combined arm

observation: The layer-marker deficit has a neuron-stage component reversible without touching radial glia
possible_role: compartment reachable after the radial-glia phase; MYC role in it unknown
action: stage-restricted manipulation at neuron stage only
outcome_to_measure: layer marker fractions plus MYC in neurons
possible_compound: neuron-promoter vectors as in the source
control_experiment: MYC lowering at neuron stage only versus progenitor stage only

observation: MYC activation can depend on mitochondrial remodelling in adult stem cells
possible_role: metabolic dependence of the MYC program (adult stem cells, not radial glia)
action: not chosen; metabolic readouts added as controls
outcome_to_measure: mitochondrial mass and morphology, ATP in MYC-high versus MYC-low radial glia

observation: Correction of proliferation versus correction of maturation and function (E27 uninformative)
possible_role: outcomes kept apart: progenitor fraction, neuron markers, network activity, seizure phenotype
outcome_to_measure: report each separately; no inference from one to the next

observation: In the cited chick and mouse tissue models MYC gain gives more neurons and fewer progenitors; in the WWOX knockout organoids MYC is up while neurons are down and radial glia up
possible_role: transferring the gain-of-function models predicts the wrong sign: the MYC rise may be compensatory, ineffective or counterbalanced; MYC lowering carries the sign hazard of T01
outcome_to_measure: direction of the neuron and radial-glia fractions when MYC is raised or lowered in isogenic lines
control_experiment: corrected line with the same manipulation

observation: Wnt (TCF4 raised) and p53 (high) are measured in the same knockout NSCs; A51 also acts on Wnt, CKI alpha and CDK7/9
possible_role: alternative or parallel drivers of the state; the A51 effect cannot be attributed to MYC
outcome_to_measure: Wnt and p53 read-outs with and without MYC lowering
control_experiment: wild-type plus tool and knockout plus vehicle arms (absent in the A51 experiment)
